findings.statement: A second set is published under the johahi account: fungi upstream and downstream k1 models, a yeast start-site model, and specieslm-metazoa-upstream-k6, read here at revision 744863be.
findings.source_says: The Hugging Face listing gives only the id "johahi/specieslm-fungi-yeastss-upstream-k1"; no source read explains what "yeastss" means.
findings.fix: A second set is published under the johahi account: specieslm-fungi-upstream-k1, specieslm-fungi-downstream-k1, specieslm-fungi-yeastss-upstream-k1 (the sources do not describe this one) and specieslm-metazoa-upstream-k6, read here at revision 744863be.

summary: Reliable. Architecture, input lengths, parameter counts, branch revisions and the TraitGym link all match the saved files; one sentence reads a meaning into the 'yeastss' checkpoint name that no source gives.
